title: US inflation statistics estimate the rent of owner-occupied homes
body: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics includes owners' equivalent rent in its Consumer Price Index. It estimates changes in the rental value of the shelter a homeowner uses, even when no rent is paid.
takeaway: The price of using a house and the price of buying that asset can move differently.
source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Rent and Rental Equivalence in the CPI
visual: the lit windows of two similar houses on a quiet street

title: Botswana's government owns half of the diamond miner Debswana
body: Debswana operates as an equal partnership between Botswana's government and the De Beers group. Each holds half of the company, which mines diamonds in Botswana.
takeaway: A government can share in mining profits through ownership as well as collecting taxes on the activity.
source: World Bank, Botswana Mining Investment and Governance Review (2017)
visual: an uncut diamond resting on dark ore under a small examination lamp
